pages.text: $(bold)Hastur's Malice$() (the default trait of the Hastur's Malice material)$(br2)Effect: while attacking, it $(bold)creates a wind field$() that attracts nearby creatures and $(bold)deals continuous damage$() to everything inside it.$(br2)The wind field drags enemies toward the focal point and grinds away at them over time — ideal for clustering mobs before following up with area damage or a domain slash.
